# Observability — Future Scope

Everything below is **deliberately not built now**. It's documented so the path is clear when a real trigger appears — not so it gets scheduled prematurely.

## 1. Request Correlation Across Features
**What**: Thread the `requestId` (already generated by `pino-http` in Stage 1) through any job or async call triggered by a request, so all logs for one user action can be pulled together.
**Trigger**: Debugging a cross-feature flow (e.g. payment → notification → receipt) from logs alone becomes genuinely slow.
**Cost to add**: Config/wiring only — no new tools, a few hours.

## 2. Centralized Log Aggregation (Grafana Loki)
**What**: Ship stdout logs via Promtail/Grafana Alloy to Loki; query/filter logs in Grafana instead of the hosting provider's built-in viewer.
**Trigger**: More than one deployed service, or log volume/retention needs outgrow what the hosting log viewer offers.
**Note**: Because Pino already outputs structured JSON (Stage 1), this addition requires **zero application code changes** — it's purely an infrastructure/shipper addition.
**Watch for**: label cardinality (don't label by `userId`/`requestId` — Loki indexes labels, not full text).

## 3. Metrics (Prometheus + Grafana)
**What**: `prom-client` exposes a `/metrics` endpoint; Prometheus scrapes it; Grafana visualizes request duration, error rate, and 1–2 business metrics per feature (e.g. `payments.transactions_total`, `notifications.sent_total`).
**Trigger**: A real need to see trends/latency over time, not just individual errors — e.g. noticing payments are slowly getting slower, not just occasionally failing.
**Not needed for**: Just knowing "is something broken" — Sentry already answers that.

## 4. Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry + Tempo)
**What**: Auto-instrument Express/DB/Redis calls with OTel; visualize a single request's path across service boundaries in Tempo; link `trace_id` into Pino logs.
**Trigger**: The app splits into multiple independently-deployed services that call each other. For a single monolithic process, this adds cost with no real payoff — request correlation (item 1) already covers the single-process case.

## 5. Dashboards & On-Call Alerting
**What**: Per-feature Grafana dashboards (payments, notifications, jobs); Prometheus alert rules → Slack/PagerDuty; formal on-call rotation.
**Trigger**: Uptime becomes business-critical — e.g. paying tenants/societies with an expectation of SLA-backed uptime, or the app scales to many societies, not just one.

## 6. Multi-Tenant Observability (if the product grows beyond one society)
**What**: If this app evolves from "one society's app" into a platform serving many societies, observability needs to be tenant-aware: tag logs/errors/metrics by `societyId`, add per-tenant dashboards, and consider per-tenant rate limits/alert thresholds.
**Trigger**: Onboarding a second society/customer onto the same deployment.

## Guiding Rule for All of the Above
Don't build any item in this document until the specific trigger listed next to it has actually happened. Re-read [`01-requirements.md`](./01-requirements.md) and [`03-roadmap.md`](./03-roadmap.md) before starting any future-scope item — confirm the trigger is real, not anticipated.
